park.note: park-local; entry plaza, looking along the street promenade

surfaces.SM_SkatePier: concrete deck, edge beam, perimeter railing (blocks, not grindable), lamp posts
surfaces.SM_SkatePierPilings: concrete piles and pile caps under the deck
surfaces.SM_SkateParkFeatures: ramps (painted concrete), ledges, stairs, steel coping/edges, painted rails
surfaces.SM_SkatePath: concrete path from the road to the pier, with retaining skirts
surfaces.SM_SkateParkFurniture: timber seating, pergola and concrete planters along the promenade
surfaces.SM_SkateParkPlanting: ornamental grasses, outside all skating lines
surfaces.SM_SkateParkDecals: faded floor paint 25 mm above the deck (visual only, no collision)
